title: Petro–De la Espriella Presidential Transition Officially Begins
detail: The official transition between outgoing President Gustavo Petro and President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella commenced on July 2, ahead of the scheduled August 7 handover. Finance Minister Germán Ávila leads the outgoing government's coordination, while Vice President-elect José Manuel Restrepo directs the incoming team; oversight bodies including the Inspector General and Comptroller General are monitoring the process. The Inter-American Development Bank approved a non-reimbursable $60 million contribution to support the transition. De la Espriella has said he will not personally attend any Casa de Nariño transition meetings before taking office — an unprecedented move for a Colombian handover.
